bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
src="738f3bdbaa6465d32b9fbb4cca8ab6829f83a32e"
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-regression-738f3bd-20261119"
test -d "$root" || exit 60
if [ -e "$stage" ]; then
 test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 61
else
 git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin "$src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 62
 test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 63
 git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$stage" "$src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
fi
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain)" || exit 65
docker build --network host --pull=false --target build -f "$stage/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:report-regression-738f3bd "$stage" >/tmp/gace-bug-report-regression-build.log 2>&1 || exit 66
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:report-regression-738f3bd --import tsx --test artifacts/bot/tests/bugReportHandlers.test.ts >/tmp/gace-bug-report-regression-test.log 2>&1 || exit 67
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 68
echo BUG_REPORT_REGRESSION_TEST=PASS
echo USERBOT_SERVICE_PRESERVED=PASS
